verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear top-to-bottom flow (brand, product, headline, copy, CTA) with a strong headline. But the can is shrunk and sits off the glow circle, which floats to the left behind nothing. The three badges are jammed together at top-left with the tilted ONLINE ONLY pill, and they don't line up with the logo on the right. 'Swipe up to shop' is blown up into a mid-size line wedged between the body copy and the CTA. B puts the headline above the product, so the hero can is pushed into the bottom-left corner, cut off from its glow circle, which now sits behind the headline. The badges and CTA float on the right as a separate cluster, and the oversized 'Swipe up to shop' comes before the product and CTA. The result is a split, lopsided layout with dead space at the bottom right and a reading order that jumps around.
